subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: Should OpenClaw expose or reuse a bounded operator-configurable cap for generic media-store and sandbox staging, or keep the 5 MiB generic cap and only land narrow channel/document exceptions?
rationale: The source-level issue is clear, but the broad fix changes resource-limit defaults, config surface, disk exposure, and sandbox media access boundaries that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
options.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract for media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults, with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow Channel Fixes Only
options.body: Keep the generic 5 MiB cap and land focused exceptions only where downstream channel limits and proof justify them.

options.title: Keep 5 MiB Intentional
options.body: Document the 5 MiB generic staging cap as a safety default and close the broader configurability request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
recommendation.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract for media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults, with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The cross-cutting cap policy spans original media support, sandbox safety, and operator-controlled security defaults.
